prompt: State what is meant by an ideal gas.
answer: A gas that obeys the equation of state pV = nRT (or pV proportional to T) at all pressures, volumes, and thermodynamic temperatures.

mark_scheme.criterion: gas that obeys pV proportional to T (or pV = nRT)

Specify the temperature scale and state that this relationship holds under all conditions.
